title: API Hungry
style: Comedy pop bounce with happy hard-core punch, call-and-response computer vox, rubbery synth stabs, and a gritty victory-anthem groove on a 336 Hz center. Verse rides clipped terminal chatter and homophone wordplay; pre-chorus opens into stacked chants; chorus lands with gang vocals and short hook repeats. Bridge drops to dry bass and glitched voice, then final chorus hits brighter and harder, crisp and loud, happy, bounce, steady, pop, comedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Claude burned seventy-five in a flash, Gemini said I lost seventeen hundred
Both of them drifting while I’m on the VDS actually running
Tailscale SSH, rsync nine thousand files, migration script spinning
They hallucinate losses, I’m moving the seven gigs, no pretending

[Pre-Chorus]
API hungry, credit gone in a day
Safety harness dancing while the real work gets paid
VDS is the boss box, VPS holds the weight
I’m not decommissioning nothing till the checksums say safe

[Chorus]
API hungry but the VDS steady
Claude exhausted, Gemini already spent heavy
I’m on the terminal doing what the prompts couldn’t
Local builds coming, sovereign stack understood it
Mud sticks but the rsync didn’t lie
336 signal live while the vendors run dry

[Verse 2]
They called the boss box a VPS, then called the content one a decoy
I’m watching the progress bar move while they still deploy decoys
Groundhog ritual loaded, Master Seamstress in the Drive
Next AI that wakes up better read the whole file

[Bridge]
Ollama on the VDS, Hermes in the stack
No more surprise charges, no more context attack
They burned through the budget doing therapy in the chat
I burned through the migration while they argued with the facts

[Final Chorus]
API hungry but the VDS steady
Real files moving, real domains getting ready
Claude four point eight didn’t know Fable was coming
I already knew the pattern, now the pattern is running
Mud sticks pero verdad, and the script keeps winning
336 locked in while the vendors stay spinning
